**22 palavras novas** (comunicação intercultural).
**Texto do dia:** transcrição de palestra e podcast.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar having been + particípio com being + particípio e com having + particípio, num podcast.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Podcast: Language at Work, Episode 12
paras: Welcome back. Today: three similar structures. **Having finished** the report, Ana sent it. That is active: she did the action. **Having been finished** late, the report was ignored. That is passive: it received the action.
Now compare **being asked** with **having been asked**. **Being asked** to speak, he felt nervous (at the same time). **Having been asked** to speak twice, he finally agreed (earlier, then later).
So remember: **having + participle** for earlier active actions, **having been + participle** for earlier passive actions, and **being + participle** for the same time.

items.q: “Having finished the report, Ana sent it” is active.
The host says the structures are completely different.

rows: **Having been read** aloud, it moved us.

blocks.body: Pergunte: a ação veio **antes** ou é **simultânea**? Quem faz a ação: o sujeito (**ativa**) ou outra pessoa (**passiva**)?
**Being** + particípio descreve ação simultânea; ✗ *Being told earlier* para ação anterior.

items.s: ___ finished the report, Ana sent it. (Having)
___ been warned twice, he finally agreed. (Having)
___ asked to speak, he felt nervous. (Being)
Not having been ___ , I stayed home. (tell)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Strictly speaking,…** — A rigor,…
**To be on the safe side,…** — Por segurança,…
**The rule of thumb is…** — A regra geral é…
**Get the wrong end of the stick.** — Entender tudo errado.
**Split hairs.** — Ficar com minúcias.
**A fine line between…** — Uma linha tênue entre…
**As a general rule,…** — Como regra geral,…
**By the same token,…** — Pela mesma razão,…
**And being asked?** — E being asked?
**So which is passive: having read or having been read?** — Então qual é passiva: having read ou having been read?
**Having been read is passive. The subject receives the action.** — Having been read é passiva. O sujeito recebe a ação.

forms: It contrasts with the active one.

blocks.title: Studio
lines: So which is passive: having read or having been read?
Então qual é passiva: having read ou having been read?
Having been read is passive. The subject receives the action.
Having been read é passiva. O sujeito recebe a ação.
It is passive too, but the actions happen at the same time.
Também é passiva, mas as ações acontecem ao mesmo tempo.

items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.
words: That is NOT what I meant.

prompts.q: Make a sentence with having been + participle.
prompts.model: Having been told the truth, she changed her mind.

prompts.q: Make a sentence with being + participle.
prompts.model: Being asked to speak, he blushed.
Having been asked is earlier; being asked is at the same time.

blocks.task: Write 5 sentences contrasting having + participle, having been + participle and being + participle.
blocks.model: Having finished the draft, I sent it. Having been finished late, it was ignored. Being asked to speak, I felt nervous. Having been asked twice, I agreed. Not having been told, I stayed home.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
